description: Defines the SchemaInfo class which wraps around c10::FunctionSchema to provide argument behavior analysis such as mutability, aliasing, and special cases within the torch::utils namespace.

classes.name: SchemaInfo
classes.description: A wrapper class for c10::FunctionSchema that provides methods to analyze argument mutability, aliasing, and other behaviors.

methods.name: is_mutable
methods.description: Checks if the schema or specific argument is mutable.

methods.name: is_mutable(const c10::SchemaArgument& argument)
methods.description: Checks if a specific argument is mutable.

methods.name: is_mutable(std::string_view name)
methods.description: Checks if an argument identified by name is mutable.

methods.name: has_argument(std::string_view name)
methods.description: Checks if an argument with the given name exists.

methods.name: is_nondeterministic
methods.description: Determines if the schema operation is nondeterministic.

methods.name: may_alias(const c10::SchemaArgument& lhs, const c10::SchemaArgument& rhs)
methods.description: Checks if two arguments may alias directly.

methods.name: may_contain_alias(const c10::SchemaArgument& lhs, const c10::SchemaArgument& rhs, bool bidirectional = true)
methods.description: Checks if two arguments may alias directly or via container.

methods.name: addArgumentValue(const std::string& name, const at::IValue& value)
methods.description: Adds a value for a specific argument by name.

methods.name: addArgumentValues(const std::vector<std::optional<at::IValue>>& value_list)
methods.description: Adds multiple argument values from a list.

methods.name: addArgumentValues(const std::unordered_map<std::string, at::IValue>& values)
methods.description: Adds multiple argument values from a map.

methods.name: hasInputArgumentNamed(const std::string& name) const
methods.description: Checks if an input argument with the specified name exists.
